page_title: RBL 2-2 LEV | RB Leipzig v Bayer Leverkusen 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Bastian Dankert is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+1' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
88' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) for a tough tackle.
85' 2 - 2 OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is unlucky enough to head the ball into his own net. 2:2.
85' No offside! Referee Bastian Dankert points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The RB Leipzig players celebrate.
85' Attention! Referee Bastian Dankert straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
85' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out for offside!
84' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a strong challenge and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
81' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
79' A yellow card for a tackle by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig). Bastian Dankert doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
77' A precise low pass is received by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
75' The referee blows his whistle as David Raum (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in his challenge.
74' A substitution has been made. Lois Openda goes off and Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) comes on.
73' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastian Dankert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

71' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) inside the box and he manages to steer it low to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Lukas Hradecky makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
71' The ball goes out for a corner. RB Leipzig can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
69' The resulting corner, taken by David Raum (RB Leipzig), comes to nothing.
69' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for RB Leipzig.
68' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul. Bastian Dankert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
67' Substitution. Lukas Klostermann makes way for Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig).
67' Here's the change. Antonio Nusa leaves the pitch and Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
66' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) coming on for Arthur.
65' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Patrik Schick is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).

64' What a great touch by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.

63' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Peter Gulacsi guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
60' 3:3 – the corner kicks stats.
57' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Bastian Dankert immediately signals a free kick.
56' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
55' A spell of possession for RB Leipzig in an attempt to control the game.
51' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Arthur Vermeeren will be replaced by Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig).
51' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas Seiwald.
49' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

47' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
46' Xabi Alonso makes a half-time substitution. Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Robert Andrich.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Bastian Dankert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) is adjudged offside.
45+1' The corner kick from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
44' David Raum (RB Leipzig) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. RB Leipzig force a corner. They send men into the box.
42' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

41' 1 - 2 Goal! David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the resulting free-kick from the edge of the box, but the ball takes a deflection off a defender and goes past the helpless Lukas Hradecky and into the net. 1:2.
40' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Bastian Dankert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
38' Bastian Dankert sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
36' The Bayer Leverkusen players halt their celebrations as referee Bastian Dankert makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
36' 0 - 2 Goal! Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Florian Wirtz, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
32' A pass from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by Lukas Hradecky and the move breaks down.
31' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
30' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

30' Great save! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Peter Gulacsi. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
28' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is flagged for offside.
27' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
27' The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
26' A lofted cross from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
25' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
24' The linesman raises his flag. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
23' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) commits a rough foul. Bastian Dankert stops the game and makes a call.
19' Referee Bastian Dankert signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Bayer Leverkusen players have a reason to celebrate!
19' The Bayer Leverkusen players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:1.

18' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the right post and ricochets away.
16' David Raum (RB Leipzig) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
14' Ball possession – 64:36.

11' Lukas Hradecky makes a brilliant save! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!

10' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Peter Gulacsi does well to punch it away.
7' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but it's cleared.
7' David Raum (RB Leipzig) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and RB Leipzig will have a corner.
6' RB Leipzig keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
4' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
3' The corner from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Peter Gulacsi.

3' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
2' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a chip pass into the box, but Peter Gulacsi is quickest to intercept the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
